tips.text: Press **Ctrl+B** to jump straight to the block search at the top of the Actions toolbox, then type part of a block's name.
tips.label: Block search

tips.text: **Player blocks** are one combined block with a Player ID dropdown. The block color follows the Player Sprite ID you pick.
tips.label: Player blocks

tips.text: The **Convert blocks** turn a playfield column or row into the matching Player, Missile or Ball X or Y position, and back again.
tips.label: Convert playfield and sprite positions

tips.text: The **Title tab** draws full-screen bitmap pages with the Titlescreen Kernel, typically for a title or menu screen.
tips.label: Title tab

tips.text: The **Score tab** offers a variety of fonts, as well as tools to make or import your own.
tips.label: Score font

tips.text: The **Text Minikernel** shows a message 12 characters wide. Use A-Z, 0-9 and basic punctuation. Up to 2 lines of text are supported.
tips.label: Text tab

tips.text: **Data tables** are read-only lookup tables of byte values (0-255). Use them for level layouts, spawn patterns, timing and more.
tips.label: Data tab

tips.text: Press **Space** on the Sound tab to preview the selected sound.
tips.label: Preview a sound

tips.text: Tick **Use pattern tempo** and set a Tempo (BPM) to change the speed of just one pattern, instead of the whole song.
tips.label: Pattern tempo

tips.text: Turn off **Load last open project on startup** on the Options tab and the app always starts from an empty project.
tips.label: Load last open project on startup

tips.text: **Emulator Settings** (the gear icon) switches between the 6502.ts and gopher2600 emulators and adds TV effects such as scanlines and phosphor glow.
tips.label: Emulator settings

tips.text: **ROM size** runs from 2k up to 64k. Bigger sizes provide more room for code, graphics and sound.
tips.label: ROM size

tips.text:
**Drawing tool hotkeys**:
Pencil: B
Eraser: E
Fill: G
Eyedropper: I
Line: L
Rectangle: R
Oval: O
tips.label: Drawing tools

tips.text:
**Searching the Generated tab**:
Enter: next match
Shift+Enter: previous match
tips.label: Searching the code

tips.text: A **failed build's error message** stays until a build succeeds, and it points to the exact line of generated code the compiler stopped on.
tips.label: Errors

tips.text: Press **Ctrl+F** (Cmd+F on a Mac) to search the blocks you have already placed on the workspace. Matches are highlighted.
tips.label: Search the workspace

tips.text: Click the **+ button** on the Sprites tab to add an animation. The name you give it is what appears in every Animation dropdown.
tips.label: Add an animation

tips.text: With **per-row playfield colors** on, pick a color in the quick palette and drag across a background's row colors to paint several rows at once.
tips.label: Per-row playfield colors

tips.text: A **title page** is built from graphic cards: 48x1, 48x2, 96x2, Player sprites, Score and Space. The kernel has 8 copies of each bitmap type, shared by every page.
tips.label: Graphics

tips.text: Switch on **5 score digits** and the leftmost digit is left out so the remaining five are centered. Scores up to 99999 still show in full.
tips.label: 5 score digits

tips.text: A **text message** can be up to 240 characters. Longer ones scroll, and the Multiline option word-wraps onto a second line.
tips.label: Message text

tips.text: Click the **icon next to a value** to enter it as decimal, binary, hex, a color, or a pick from your title screens, backgrounds, sounds, songs or text.
tips.label: Value entry formats

tips.text: Switch on **Envelope** to shape a sound's volume with Attack, Decay, Sustain and Release. You can drag the points on the graph.
tips.label: Envelope

tips.text: In the **piano roll**, click a cell to place or remove a note and drag a note's right edge to change how long it lasts.
tips.label: Piano roll

tips.text: Turn on **Increment on Save** to bump the version number every time you save, writing each save to a new file.
tips.label: Increment on Save

tips.text: In the **keyboard mapping dialog**, click a control and then press the new key. Escape cancels.
tips.label: Keyboard mapping

tips.text: **Expert mode** hides the small hint text under fields and switches for a more compact layout.
tips.label: Expert mode

tips.text: **Dark Mode** and **Subdued Palette** are separate switches under VCSGM Options: use either one, or turn both on for a dark, muted look.
tips.label: Dark Mode

tips.text: **Hold Shift** while dragging a line to snap it to 45 degrees, or a rectangle or oval to make a square or circle.
tips.label: Line, Rectangle and Oval tools

tips.text: The **Generated tab** refreshes when you click Update ROM. Editing blocks does not update it by itself.
tips.label: When the code updates

tips.text: Drag the **strip along the top of the console** to make it taller or shorter.
tips.label: Resize the console

tips.text: The **wait [n] frames** block pauses for the given number of video frames. There are about 60 frames per second.
tips.label: wait [n] frames

tips.text: Each frame has a **Duration**: the number of game frames it is shown before the animation moves on to the next one.
tips.label: Frame duration

tips.text: A **background that no block ever switches to** is left out of the ROM, so unused backgrounds cost nothing.
tips.label: Unused backgrounds

tips.text: Call **Draw title screen** every frame for as long as you want the page shown, for example from "Title screen update".
tips.label: Draw title screen

tips.text: **Score Bars 1 and 2** can show health (a solid block growing from the score) or lives (evenly spaced dots).
tips.label: Score bars

tips.text: The **Scroll text** blocks add "every [n] frames" and "wait [n] at limits" fields to control how fast and how long it pauses at each end.
tips.label: Scrolling text

tips.text: The **Data table bit** block reads one bit of a value, so a single byte can hold 8 true/false flags.
tips.label: Data table bit

tips.text: The **DIM switch** plays every sound and music note at a percentage of its volume. The emulator follows it too.
tips.label: DIM

tips.text: **Mute** silences an instrument for the whole song, and **Solo** silences every other instrument so you can hear one by itself.
tips.label: Mute and Solo

tips.text: The **Example Projects** button on the Project tab lists projects you can open, with a search box to narrow them down.
tips.label: Example Projects

tips.text: The **bug icon** turns on a debug overlay with the registers, scanlines and CPU use. The **list icon** picks which variables it shows.
tips.label: Debug overlay

tips.text: **Mute in-game audio** silences everything the ROM plays while you test, without removing any sound blocks.
tips.label: Mute in-game audio

tips.text: **Mirror draw** horizontally or vertically paints the other side of the graphic as you draw. With both on, all four corners are drawn.
tips.label: Mirror and flip

tips.text: **Every [n] frames, plus [n]** runs its blocks on a power-of-2 interval, with an optional offset, so different jobs can take turns.
tips.label: Every [n] frames, plus [n]

tips.text: Press **Play** on an animation card to preview it in the emulator without building or changing your ROM.
tips.label: Preview an animation

tips.text: **Playfield area is clear** tells you whether every playfield pixel in a rectangle is off, for example to see whether all the bricks are gone.
tips.label: Playfield area is clear

tips.text: Give a title graphic a **Window height** smaller than its frame and it scrolls through its picture, using the scroll blocks.
tips.label: Title screen scrolling

tips.text: **Score digit blocks** read or change a single digit of the score without touching the others.
tips.label: Score digit blocks

tips.text: **Show text ID** picks a message with a number, so a variable can choose which message to show.
tips.label: Show text ID

tips.text: **Export to .CSV** and **Import from .CSV** move a data table's values in and out of a spreadsheet.
tips.label: Export to .CSV

tips.text: **Export bank** saves every sound on the tab into one .vcsbnk file. **Import bank** lets you pick which sounds to bring in.
tips.label: Export bank

tips.text: The **target icon** makes the visible pattern follow playback as the song moves through its sequence.
tips.label: Auto-switch to the playing pattern

tips.text: The **Sound Banks** button on the Project tab lists sounds and banks you can import into the open project.
tips.label: Sound Banks

tips.text: The **camera icon** saves the emulator picture as a PNG. The **full screen icon** shows it full screen, and Esc leaves.
tips.label: Screenshot button

tips.text: **Show remaining CPU cycles as the score** shows roughly how many cycles are left in the frame, white when there is room and red when over budget.
tips.label: Show remaining CPU cycles

tips.text:
**Selection tools** pick the cells that Move, Flip and Delete act on:
Rectangle select: M
Circle select: C
Polygon select: P
tips.label: Selection tools

tips.text: A **Run once** block only runs the first time it is reached and is skipped every time after.
tips.label: Run once

tips.text: Drag the **grab strip** across the top of a frame onto another frame to reorder frames. A bar shows where it will land.
tips.label: Reorder frames

tips.text: Combine **Find playfield pixel collided with** and **Background Clear pixel** to break exactly the wall pixel a shot hit.
tips.label: Find playfield pixel

tips.text: Press the **play icon** on a title page to test just that page in the emulator without building your whole project.
tips.label: Test a title screen

tips.text: Pick **Custom** as the score font to draw the digits yourself. **Use extra glyphs** adds 6 more drawable symbols.
tips.label: Extra glyphs

tips.text: Turn on **Show a scroll cursor** to draw blinking arrows (and an end-of-message icon) next to messages with more than 2 lines.
tips.label: Scroll cursor

tips.text: A **data table that no block reads** is left out of the ROM entirely, so unused tables cost nothing.
tips.label: Unused data tables

tips.text: **Play sound [type] with frequency, volume and duration** plays a one-off sound without needing a sound card.
tips.label: Play sound [type]

tips.text:
**Music playback hotkeys**:
Shift+Space: play just the current pattern
Space: play the whole pattern sequence
tips.label: Play a pattern

tips.text: The Title, Developer, Version and other **Project Settings** fields are also written as a comment at the top of the generated code.
tips.label: Project Settings

tips.text: The **ROM capacity panel** under the emulator shows how much ROM and how many variables your project uses after each build.
tips.label: ROM capacity

tips.text: The **DPC+ kernel** (experimental) adds Players 2 to 9, sound chip audio and per-background playfield row counts.
tips.label: DPC+ kernel

tips.text:
**Image hotkeys**:
Shift+E: export the current frame as a PNG
Shift+I: import an image into the graphic
tips.label: Image files

tips.text: **On even frames** and **On odd frames** run different blocks depending on the current frame, handy for splitting heavy work across two frames.
tips.label: On even / odd frames

tips.text: Turn on **per-row sprite colors** on the Options tab and every sprite frame gets a color strip, one color per row.
tips.label: Per-row sprite colors

tips.text: A background can be taller than the screen. **Playfield scroll** with "stop at edge" ticked stops cleanly on its first and last row.
tips.label: Playfield scroll

tips.text: A title graphic with several frames animates by itself. Switch on **Play animation once** to make it stop on its last frame.
tips.label: Play animation once

tips.text: Tag a sound with the **piano icon** to make it an Instrument. Only instruments show up in the Music tab's instrument dropdown.
tips.label: Instrument tag

tips.text: **Export song** saves a song as a .vcsmus file, and **Export song bank** saves every song with the instruments they use.
tips.label: Export song bank

tips.text: Every saved project includes a **screenshot of the emulator**, taken after the last successful build.
tips.label: Save

tips.text: **Save ROM** saves the last build as a .bin or .a26 file, named after your project title and version.
tips.label: Save ROM

tips.text: On a graphic with row colors, click a **quick color** to arm it, then click or drag across the row color strip. Alt-click removes a quick color.
tips.label: Quick colors

tips.text: **Define function** creates a reusable block that takes parameters and can return a value. Call it as a statement or inside an expression.
tips.label: Define function

tips.text: Untick **loop** when you set an animation to make it play once and freeze on its last frame. "When Player animation has finished" then runs.
tips.label: Animation loop

tips.text: Press **Play** on a background card to preview just that background in the emulator, without building your ROM.
tips.label: Preview a background

tips.text: **End title screen** stops the Titlescreen Kernel and shows the regular game screen from the next frame on.
tips.label: End title screen

tips.text: The **Vol row** under the piano roll sets a single note's volume as a percentage of the instrument's base volume.
tips.label: Volume row

tips.text: Drag the **emulator pane's left edge** to resize it, or use the **chevron tab** on its edge to hide it and make room for blocks.
tips.label: Resize the emulator pane

tips.text: **Set height** resizes a graphic. It can scale the contents to fit and apply the new height to every frame of the animation.
tips.label: Set height

tips.text: **Change state to** switches between the Title screen, Gameplay and Gameover states. Each state has start and update events.
tips.label: Change state to

tips.text: **Player set width/quantity** gives the player 2 or 3 copies, or doubles or quadruples its size.
tips.label: Player set width/quantity

tips.text: **Reordering backgrounds** renumbers them and updates every block that referred to one by its ID.
tips.label: Reordering backgrounds

tips.text: A **48-wide title graphic** can have a colored area behind its picture.
tips.label: Picture background

tips.text: **Distance X** and **Distance Y** between two objects give an always-positive distance, handy for checking whether something is close.
tips.label: Distance between objects

tips.text: **Import animation frames** picks several image files at once. Files numbered like walk1.png, walk2.png are ordered by their number.
tips.label: Import animation frames

tips.text: The **Fire block** launches a missile or the ball and moves it by itself until it leaves the screen. Set the direction with an angle or a Joystick direction block.
tips.label: Fire block

tips.text: The **Joystick Fire block** can read a pattern of presses (tapped, double-tapped, and held), counted in frames. 60 frames is one second.
tips.label: Joystick Fire pattern

tips.text: **Switch blocks** have a "was just switched on" mode that is true for one frame per press, so the blocks under it run once instead of every frame the switch is held.
tips.label: Console switches

tips.text: **Undo last move** reverts a player's position if it collided with the playfield last frame. Place it before the blocks that move the player.
tips.label: Undo last move

tips.text: **Bounce** reflects an object off whatever it just collided with. Call it every frame the collision lasts.
tips.label: Bounce

tips.text: The **Seek block** moves an object toward a target X/Y and stops on arrival.
tips.label: Seek

tips.text: **Set random seed** reseeds the random number generator, so a game does not repeat the same sequence every run.
tips.label: Set random seed

tips.text: The Fire block's **check playfield while moving** option moves the object one pixel at a time, so a fast missile cannot jump over a thin playfield pixel.
tips.label: Check playfield while moving
